response_text: Yes, the OS would still work. However, with only one thread, there’s no real multitasking happening, since the scheduler has no other threads to switch to. This means the CPU will repeatedly run the same thread after each yield, resulting in behavior similar to a simple loop rather than a multitasking system. Consequently, while the OS won’t crash or hang, it won’t be able to perform multiple tasks concurrently, which limits its usefulness in managing multiple operations or responding to asynchronous events.\n
